panels.title: Rows by label_source, per hour
panels.description: How each pull request got its label. A rising fallback share means the model is degrading or unreachable. A rising model_retry share means its output is getting messier.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', triaged_at) AS time,
  label_source AS metric,
  count(*)::int AS value
FROM pr_triage
WHERE $__timeFilter(triaged_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Model latency per call, p50 and p95 (ms)
panels.description: latency_ms covers the whole loop, so it is divided by llm_calls to get per-call. Excludes skipped rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', triaged_at) AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms::float / GREATEST(llm_calls, 1)) AS p50_ms,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms::float / GREATEST(llm_calls, 1)) AS p95_ms
FROM pr_triage
WHERE $__timeFilter(triaged_at) AND llm_calls > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
